description: Header file defining functions, enums, and macros related to binder stability and interface versioning in Android's native binder implementation.

methods.name: AIBinder_markVendorStability
methods.description: Marks a binder interface as having vendor image stability.

methods.name: AIBinder_forceDowngradeToVendorStability
methods.description: Downgrades a binder interface to vendor stability.

methods.name: AIBinder_markSystemStability
methods.description: Marks a binder interface as having system image stability.

methods.name: AIBinder_forceDowngradeToSystemStability
methods.description: Downgrades a binder interface to system stability.

methods.name: AIBinder_markVintfStability
methods.description: Marks a binder interface as having VINTF stability.
